title: External Web Access for Web Search on Amazon Bedrock
hook: What does the external_web_access parameter enable in Amazon Bedrock Web Search?

back.lead: The external_web_access parameter allows Web Search to retrieve content directly from the public web so models can ground responses with current web knowledge.
back.hookline: Public web retrieval now available for Bedrock Web Search.

kv.v: Retrieve content directly from public web
